changeSet.author: Tazeen Shaukat
changeSet.neo4j:cypher: CREATE INDEX term_icdo_relationship_lookup_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (t:term) ON (t._commit, t.origin_id, t.origin_name)
CREATE INDEX concept_nanoid_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (c:concept) ON (c.nanoid)
CREATE INDEX tag_nanoid_idx IF NOT EXISTS FOR (tag:tag) ON (tag.nanoid)

changeSet.author: Tazeen Shaukat
changeSet.neo4j:cypher:
CALL { MATCH (t:term) WHERE t.origin_id = "8000/0" AND t._commit = "CDEPV-20260428" AND t.origin_name IN ["ICDO", "ICDO_SYNONYM"]
WITH collect(DISTINCT t) AS terms
MERGE (c:concept {nanoid: "HVVrs5"}) ON CREATE SET c._commit = "CDEPV-20260428"
MERGE (tag:tag {nanoid: "BnWwqn"}) ON CREATE SET tag.key = "mapping_src", tag.value = "ICDO3.2"
MERGE (c)-[:has_tag]->(tag)
WITH c, terms
UNWIND terms AS t MERGE (t)-[:represents]->(c) }
